work_objects.name: Credit Rating
work_objects.description: A numerical expression representing the creditworthiness of a contract.

work_objects.name: Credit Rating Report
work_objects.description: A report generated by the rating agency website detailing the credit rating.

work_objects.name: Risk Assessment
work_objects.description: An evaluation of the risk associated with the contract based on the credit rating report.

work_objects.name: Voting Result
work_objects.description: The decision made by the risk manager regarding the risk assessment.

work_objects.name: Contract
work_objects.description: The agreement that is signed by the risk manager after the voting result.
